    About this product

    'Spinach PUFFERZ Grape Gas isn't just a vape, but a fun, multi-sensory experience stuffed into one puffy device....

    'Spinach PUFFERZ Grape Gas isn't just a vape, but a fun, multi-sensory experience stuffed into one puffy device. Puff, Puff, don't pass on this all-in-one vape that's designed to delight your senses and deliver bigger, more potent hits thanks to our liquid diamonds infusion. We've dialled up the grape flavour notes so that each time you sesh, you're puffing in style with this new vape design. Sweet, juicy, and absolutely ripe for any good session. Spinach PUFFERZ Grape Gas has refreshing grape flavour notes from right off the vine and powered- up gas aromas straight from the pump. With inspiration from a strain with a Grape ?and Jet Fuel GLTO lineage, each puff goes full throttle with a liquid diamonds filled potency of 98.1% THC. Fill your basket and your tank in this powerful, puffy all-in-one vape. '

    This site uses cookies to improve your browsing experience, analyze website traffic, and personalize content. For more information on the purposes of these cookies, and to customize your preferences by type of cookies used, click on "Manage Preferences" below.

    You can change your preferences at any time, including to withdraw consent for the use of optional cookies, by clicking on "Cookies Preferences" in the website footer.
    Your Individual Settings
    Here you can enable or disable optional services. By clicking "Allow All Cookies," you enable all optional purposes/providers. By clicking "Allow Only Strictly Necessary Cookies," you disable all optional purposes/providers. By clicking "Save," you apply your individual selection. You can change your preferences at any time via "Cookies Preferences" in the website footer.
    Technical Cookies – Strictly Necessary
    Always Active
    These cookies are technically necessary for the proper functioning of this website. These cookies are set without a visitor's consent:

    _shopify_y (visitor identifier used to maintain consistent user experience across sessions; retention: 1 year)
    _shopify_s (session token used to track activity within a single browsing session; retention: 30 minutes)
    shopify_client_id (customer identifier used to associate browser with Shopify account or guest session; retention: 1 year)
    localization (customer's location and currency preference, to ensure correct language and pricing is displayed; retention: session)
    cart (stores content of user's shopping cart during and between sessions; retention: session)
    osid (session identifier, to maintain authenticated or anonymous user state during browsing; retention: session)
    encKJASd73 (encrypted session token to secure user interactions and prevent session tampering; retention: session)
    datadome (fraud prevention, set by third party Datadome; retention: 1 year)
    cart_currency (stores user's selected cart currency for consistent pricing display; retention: session)
    global_province (stores user's province or region to determine applicable regulations and product availability; retention: session)
    global_store_id (identifies the specific store location associated with the user's session; retention: session)
    _pandectes_gdpr (cookie consent management, set by third party Pandectes; retention: 1 year)
    Performance Cookies
    These cookies are used to enhance user experience on the website, including storing certain settings and preferences that you may set while browsing for better site personalization and loyalty program recognition.

    hightideinc-_zldp (loyalty program recognition for enhanced access to customer support; retention: 1 year)
    hightideinc-_zldt (loyalty program recognition for current browsing session; retention: session)
    _lc2_fpi (recognizes returning users to maintain support chat history and improve support experience, set by third party LiveChat; retention: approximately 400 days)
    CYB_AB (A/B testing cookie assigning visitor to test variant to maintain consistency across session; retention: session)
    Analytics Cookies
    These cookies collect information about how you interact with the site, such as the pages visited, session duration, traffic sources and browsing patterns. This data is then used to improve site performance.

    First Party:
    user_id_t (assigns unique identifier to each visitor for internal analytics and personalization; retention: 1 year)
    _vt_user (identifies and maintains unique visitor profile across sessions; retention: 1 year)

    Google Analytics 4:
    _ga (assigns a unique client ID to distinguish users and measure site traffic; retention: 2 years)
    _ga_* (property-specific GA cookie, stores engagement data; retention: 2 years)
    _gid (stores a unique value for each page visited; retention: 24 hours)

    Microsoft Clarity:
    _clck (persistent user identifier, tracks user across sessions for heatmap and session recording; retention: session)
    _clsk (groups all activity within a single visit for session replay; retention: session)

    Snowplow:
    _sp_id.* (persistent user ID, identifies user across sessions for data warehouse analytics; retention: 2 years)
    _sp_ses.* (tracks whether user is in an active session; retention: 30 minutes)

    Amplitude:
    AMP_6d4915888 (stores session and user data for product analytics and behavioural tracking; retention: session)
    Marketing Cookies
    These cookies are used to track visitors across websites to serve relevant advertising and attribute conversions to specific marketing campaigns.

    First Party:
    ret_sess (identifies whether user has been exposed to a retargeting campaign; retention: session)
    retuser_id_ct (used to recognize audience segments for personalized advertising; retention: 1 year)
    lantern (tailors product recommendations to the visitor; retention: 1 year)
    is_elite (indicates user's loyalty tier, to personalize pricing and access; retention: session)
    trackcb (conversion tracking for marketing campaign attribution; retention: session)

    Google Ads:
    _gcl_au (conversion tracking for marketing campaign attribution; retention: 90 days)
    first_pla_call (conversion tracking for marketing campaign attribution; retention: session)

    Klaviyo:
    __kla_id (identifies user for email personalization, abandoned carts, list segmentation; retention: 2 years)

    AddShoppers:
    addshoppers.com (social sharing and referral tracking; retention: 1 year)

    Yotpo:
    yotpo_pixel (tracks user activity for reviews, loyalty, and user generated content platform attribution; retention: session)

    PushOwl:
    po_visitor (tracks whether visitor has opted in to browser push notification campaigns; retention: 1 year)

    Impact.com:
    IR_PI / IR_gbd / IR_10322 (stores impression data, geo/browser context, and programme ID for granular affiliate marketing attribution; retention: 1 year)
    irclickid (conversion tracking for marketing campaign/affiliate partner referrals; retention: 30 days)

    Commission Junction:
    ccid.* (conversion tracking for marketing campaign/affiliate partner referrals; retention: 13 months)

    Snapchat:
    __fpcnsc (conversion tracking for marketing campaign referrals; retention: 13 months)

    RevOffers:
    revoffers_affil (conversion tracking for marketing campaign/affiliate partner referrals; retention: 1 year)

    LiveRamp:
    _cc_id (cross-site audience targeting and measurement; retention: 1 year)

    Prebid:
    _pubcid (programmatic advertising and ad targeting; retention: 1 year)

    Lotame:
    panoramId / panoramIdType / panoramID_expiry (cross-site audience profiling for data-driven ad targeting and measurement; retention: 1 year)

    Skimlinks/SA:
    sa-user-id / v2 / v3 / v4 (conversion tracking for marketing campaign/affiliate partner referrals; retention: 1 year)
    sa-r-source / sa-r-date (referral source and date, for affiliate attribution; retention: 1 year)

    Amazon:
    _ama (conversion tracking for marketing campaign/affiliate partner referrals; retention: 1 year)

    Justuno:
